items.item: This topic leaves out the isolation-spectrum theory, row/column security mechanisms, FinOps practice, engine resource-governance internals, and the Chapter 13 erasure mechanisms.
Tenant isolation spectrums, noisy-neighbour quotas, and usage-based cost attribution are each established practice, not an emerging technique.
This topic gives the shop its isolation and attribution model; the next design must compose erasure across the lakehouse and its backups.
A shared warehouse with no per-tenant limit lets one tenant's heavy query degrade every neighbour, with no way to even identify the cause.
